exact_certificate.D_definition: D_j = product_{prime p<=Y} p^v_p(N_j), with exact valuations
exact_certificate.residual_roughness: No prime <=Y divides N_j/D_j: every such valuation was removed in full
exact_certificate.late_axis_for_covered_positions: If D_j>1, choose any prime q dividing N_j/D_j. Then q>Y and m=N_j/q>=D_j>=3. Both q and m are odd. Since N_j<=3P+4, either q>P or m>P would imply N_j>=3(P+2)>3P+4. Thus Y<q<=P and 3<=m<=P: a valid later axis in S_P.
exact_certificate.absorption: C_{p<=Y}(I) is a subset of C_{Y<p<=P}(I) on this fixed window
exact_certificate.conditional_UNKNOWN_statement: For D_j=1 no compositeness is established. If N_j is composite, all its prime factors exceed Y and at least one is an admissible later axis in S_P.
exact_certificate.scope: Only the stated window; q values are not produced; no new prime is certified

a_star_bounds.definition: a_star(I)=min_{n composite in I} P_plus(n), where P_plus is the largest prime divisor
a_star_bounds.upper_bound_proof: N_17 is composite. Every prime dividing N_17 divides either D_17 or N_17/D_17. Since N_17>D_17^2, both kinds of factors are <=N_17/D_17. The minimum over all composite window addresses cannot exceed this bound.
